summary: The group holds 448 input rows: 434 in system_a, 8 in odm_a and 6 in product_a. It has three parts. Fonts: 210 system font entries (204 TrueType or OpenType files, two CJK TrueType collections, four symlinks) and six product fonts; system fonts are indexed by system_a/system/etc/fonts.xml (familyset version 23, 157 families, 24 aliases) with Roboto as the default sans-serif face, and product fonts are added through product_a/etc/fonts_customization.xml. Locale data: a tzdata2021a bundle with its tz_version string, 37 hyphenation pattern (.hyb) files, two BMD binary tables read by libFFTEm.so, and a usr/icu symlink into the com.android.i18n APEX. Input configuration: 176 Linux key layout (.kl) files, six key character maps (.kcm) and eight input device configuration (.idc) files, mostly gamepad and remote-control devices plus emulator and VR entries. All 443 regular files match their recorded size and sha256, and the five symlinks resolve.
